extracted.name: Ultimate BBQ spice blend
extracted.description: Make our versatile spice blend to use in a variety of ways. If you have whole spices, toast them first in a dry frying pan for 1-2 mins until fragrant
instruction_lines: Combine the smoked paprika (10g), ground coriander (5g), ground cumin and ground fennel seed (2g), and ground allspice and ground cinnamon (0.5g). Will keep in an airtight container in a cool, dry place for up to two months.
